entwurf.beschreibung: Helsing, founded in 2021 in Munich, merges AI and drones for modern warfare. The company launched HX‑2 drones in 2024 and partnered with major European militaries for AI‑enhanced combat systems, including a 2024 contract for the Future Combat Air System. In 2025, Helsing tested its AI pilot Centaur in a Gripen dogfight, marking a first for autonomous fighter jets. Funding from Spotify’s Daniel Ek and General Catalyst has propelled Helsing to a valuation of $18 billion in 2026.

teile.name: Founding
teile.text: Helsing began as an AI firm in March 2021 by Reil, Scherf, and Köhler.
teile.szene: A sleek, modern Munich office. A trio of founders discuss AI. Early 2021. Light is natural, with blue tones.

teile.name: HX‑2 Launch
teile.text: In December 2024, Helsing unveiled the HX‑2 strike drone.
teile.szene: A runway at night. The HX‑2 drones roll out. 2024. The glow of runway lights and a calm crowd.

teile.name: Military Partnerships
teile.text: Helsing secured a contract in 2024 to build AI for the Future Combat Air System.
teile.szene: An austere conference room. Executives sign a contract. 2024. Dim lighting, serious faces.

teile.name: AI Dogfight Test
teile.text: In 2025, Helsing’s AI Centaur piloted a Gripen in a real dogfight trial.
teile.szene: A cloudy airfield. Two Gripen jets battle. 2025. Bright sunlight, birdsong.

teile.name: Funding Surge
teile.text: By July 2026, Helsing’s valuation reached $18 billion after a $1.8 billion round.
teile.szene: A boardroom. Investors nod. 2026. Fluorescent lights, tense air.

teile.name: Call to Action
teile.text: Be sure to like, share, and save this video.
teile.szene: A dynamic poster background. Text appears. 2026. Bold, neon colors.
